text:
noah.hm: Heads-up — requesting a comp-band exception for incoming senior infra engineer (IC4 -> IC5). Proposed comp: base $205,000, target bonus 15%, equity 0.35%.

zoe.recruiter: Candidate has two competing offers, requesting a 5/01 start. We need a decision fast.

maya.hr: Tagging comp-approvals. Please include manager rationale and budget confirmation. @noah.hm can you paste a short biz case?

noah.hm: Biz case: will take ownership of routing caching project; estimated to reduce infra spend by ~10% and improve p99 latency by ~30ms. Candidate has 7+ years infra experience and leadership history; we lost a near-identical candidate last month at IC4. Budget note: we can reallocate an unfilled SWE2 headcount this quarter.

ben.finance: Finance ack that budget can be reallocated but per policy director sign-off + comp-committee review required for band moves. cc @linda.dir for director pre-approval.

linda.dir: I can provisionally approve escalation to committee provided we attach measurable goals and a 6-month calibration checkpoint. If committee can't meet within 24h, I'm ok with an interim one-time hold payment of $8k to secure the candidate.

comp-bot: Request logged. Routing path: manager -> director -> finance -> comp-committee. Ticket ID CCQ-2026-2044. Standard SLA 48h. Urgent flag set by recruiter.

maya.hr: Two options on the table: 1) request urgent committee review (same-day ask) or 2) extend a provisional IC4 top-of-band offer plus one-time hold payment. Which do we proceed with?

noah.hm: Preference is IC5 to avoid churn risk. If committee cannot commit same-day, fallback to IC4 + the $8k hold payment. Also open to flexible start date to accommodate candidate's notice period.

zoe.recruiter: I'll send a provisional offer with contingent language. Draft clause: 

```
Offer is provisional and subject to final Compensation Committee approval. If the committee declines the band exception, the company will provide the top of the IC4 band plus a one-time hold payment of $8,000 payable after 30 days of employment. Final compensation will be confirmed in writing following committee decision and is subject to standard employment terms.
```

noah.hm: Thanks — please ping me once the committee chair confirms availability. Candidate expects an answer within 24h. :pray:
